# SmartyMove

> SmartyMove is the AI Movement Intelligence Platform. It turns a smartphone camera into a functional movement screen, produces the Smarty Movement Score™ (0–100) and Smarty Movement Age™, identifies the root cause of any failed test, and prescribes a personalized 5-minute daily corrective exercise program that progresses every 14 days.

## What SmartyMove is

SmartyMove is a mobile-first AI Movement Intelligence Platform. Users perform a short standardized set of five functional movement patterns (deep squat, hip hinge, active straight-leg raise, shoulder mobility, in-line lunge) in front of their phone camera. On-device AI pose detection scores each rep 0–3 against Functional Movement Screen criteria, flags compensations (heel rise, spine rounding, knee valgus, left/right asymmetry, shoulder shrug), and clusters failures into root-cause areas (Ankle, Knee, Hip, Low Back, Shoulder, Elbow, Wrist).

The Corrective Decision Engine then prescribes a personalized 14-day training plan in three phases — Foundation (weeks 0–1), Build (weeks 2–5), Maintain & Perform (weeks 6+) — built from a curated library of mobility, stability, and strength exercises across seven areas × three categories. The program rescans every 14 days and progresses automatically.

## Proprietary metrics

- **Smarty Movement Score™** — single 0–100 score summarizing movement quality (Mobility 30%, Stability 30%, Balance 20%, Movement Quality 20%).
- **Smarty Movement Age™** — age-equivalent derived from the Movement Score; answers whether a body moves younger or older than its chronological age.
- **Smarty Mobility Index™** — mobility sub-score across squat, hinge, shoulder mobility, ASLR and in-line lunge.
- **Smarty Stability Index™** — stability sub-score across the in-line lunge, single-leg control and trunk control elements of the screen.
- **Smarty Movement Intelligence™** — the combined measurable capacity of mobility, stability, balance and motor control.

## Who it's for

- Desk workers with stiff hips, low back, or shoulders
- Runners and lifters protecting their joints
- Older adults maintaining independence and balance
- Athletes chasing performance and injury prevention
- Anyone recovering from minor musculoskeletal issues who has been cleared for exercise

SmartyMove is a wellness and education tool. It is not a medical device, not a diagnosis, and not a replacement for a physiotherapist or physician.

## Core differentiators

- **AI Movement Intelligence Platform** — screening + scoring + corrective program in one system.
- **Smarty Movement Score™ and Movement Age™** — proprietary, measurable, improvable metrics.
- **Root-cause clustering** — trains the 1–2 deficits that explain the most failures.
- **Compensation detection** — verifies real range of motion versus faked motion.
- **Curated corrective library** — 7 areas × 3 categories; nothing invented or cross-prescribed.
- **On-device pose detection** — raw video is never uploaded.
- **14-day rescan cycle** — Foundation → Build → Maintain & Perform.
